name: Toast
outlook:
What Toast says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: gross profit and adjusted EBITDAFor the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, Toast expects to report: • Non-GAAP subscription services and financial technology solutions gross profit in the range of $610 million to $620 million (22-24% growth compared to Q4 2025). • Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $200 million to $210 million.
  • Full year 2026: gross profit and adjusted EBITDAFor the full year ending December 31, 2026, Toast expects to report: • Non-GAAP subscription services and financial technology solutions gross profit in the range of $2,375 million to $2,385 million (26% growth compared to 2025, up from 23-25% growth). • Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $840 million to $850 million (up from $805 million to $825 million).
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
